ranked.headline: Sequence-based models link DNA motifs, 3D chromatin structure and accessibility
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair sequence foundation models with Hi-C and nucleosome data to predict chromatin accessibility, structure and methylation.

ranked.headline: Mobile element inventories gaining benchmarks and ecological host context
ranked.summary: Soil plasmid resources and virus-host Hi-C benchmarks now tie mobile element inventories to host and ecological context.

ranked.headline: Computational methods denoise, impute and map single-cell transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs deep learning and statistical models with scRNA-seq, FISH and single-cell chromatin data to denoise, assign and map cells.

ranked.headline: Learned sequence models generate context-conditioned protein designs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply protein language models and LLMs to protein design, secretion engineering, and allergenicity prediction.

ranked.headline: Learned models score noncoding regulatory elements, variants, and transcripts
ranked.summary: Recent reports apply trained sequence models and calibrated scores to prioritize noncoding variants, regulators, and transcript isoforms.

ranked.headline: Multimodal graph neural networks predict compound properties and bioactivity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair molecular graph encoders with fingerprints, descriptors, and images across CNS, toxicity, and synergy endpoints.

ranked.headline: Learned protein embeddings predict interactions, affinity and structure reliability
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein language model and AlphaFold3 diffusion embeddings are now feeding task-specific interaction, affinity and structure-assessment predictors.

ranked.headline: Sampling frames shape which pathogen lineages enter epidemiological inference
ranked.summary: Recent 2025 studies in surveillance, hospital, and wastewater settings show sampling choices bound what downstream inference can recover.

ranked.headline: Model form and data fusion shape clinical risk and dosing predictions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test how model design, data fusion, and federated training affect clinical risk and treatment predictions.

ranked.headline: Transformer and contrastive models predict RNA, protein and peptide interaction sites
ranked.summary: Recent sequence-based deep predictors pair language-model embeddings with multi-view or relational architectures for regulatory and binding site prediction.

ranked.headline: Targeted long-read assembly and matched references sharpen genome-scale analysis
ranked.summary: Recent publications and preprints report near-complete diploid genomes and matched references alongside long-read somatic and lineage tools.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models are trained on and benchmarked against genomic variation
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs deep generative and sequence models with variant-level genomic data, from mutation rates to splice and rare-variant effects.

ranked.headline: Open-source pipelines package sequencing and omics analyses into reproducible workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release R, Nextflow, and Bioconductor tools for reproducible analysis of spatial, multi-omics, and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Open tools link simulation, prediction, and design for protein flexibility and binding
ranked.summary: Reusable open-source tools for ensemble flexibility analysis and coarse-grained topology generation are appearing across simulation and prediction workflows.

ranked.headline: Aligning unpaired and spatial omics modalities via optimal transport and graph geometry
ranked.summary: Preprints from November 2025 extend learned cross-modal alignment to histopathology, spatial proteomics, and unpaired single-cell morphology.

ranked.headline: Omitted epistasis inflates GWAS nulls; noise QTLs and metQTLs map complex-trait loci
ranked.summary: Noise QTL, metabolite QTL, and GWAS null-bias studies now test how association statistics translate into causal and mechanistic claims.

ranked.headline: Stochastic and geometric local rules shape cell migration and membrane protein transport
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study extend local-rule models to chemotaxis search, cell shape in microchannels, and membrane protein fluctuations.

ranked.headline: Learned brain graph models decode EEG, SEEG, fMRI, and structural connectome data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show learned connectivity graphs now span intracranial, EEG-fMRI, and structural connectome data for clinical and mechanistic questions.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and kernel methods infer interaction and noise structure from biological data
ranked.summary: High-dimensional omics data make fixed structural assumptions fragile, motivating models that learn interactions and noise from the data.

ranked.headline: Metabolic models integrate multi-omics to infer disease-specific metabolic states
ranked.summary: Genome-scale and gene expression metabolic models are now paired with multi-omic data to resolve disease-linked metabolic states in patient-derived systems.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked computational workflows for kinase, interaction and proteoform mapping
ranked.summary: Pooled IP-MS, haplotype-resolved proteogenomics and DIA single-cell benchmarks test how analysis choices shape proteome-level inference.

ranked.headline: Structure-constrained learned encoders predict unmeasured genes and perturbation responses
ranked.summary: Foundation models and graph-based encoders are being extended with spatial, perturbation, and network constraints for single-cell prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Standalone tools speed up sequence search, read simulation and metagenomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications report faster nucleotide search, read simulation and nanopore-based methylation motif detection in standalone tools.

ranked.headline: Causal and network methods prioritize genes, modules and disease drivers
ranked.summary: Longitudinal, single-cell, and histopathology data now feed causal and network models that rank candidate targets for intervention analysis.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer cell identity and dynamics from single-cell and spatial data
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell platforms now yield high-resolution data that benchmarks and new models must interpret accurately.

ranked.headline: Ligand binding and conformational dynamics in disordered and allosteric proteins
ranked.summary: Current MD, NMR, and Markov state model work resolves ligand binding and dynamics in disordered and allosteric proteins.

ranked.headline: Minimizer density modeling and compressed indexing for scalable DNA sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Scaling DNA sequence models and similarity search to longer contexts and larger collections demands cheaper representations and indexes.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and ML models resolve paired immune receptor chain pairing and specificity
ranked.summary: Paired-chain repertoire sequencing and benchmarks of TCR specificity methods supply measured ground truth for evaluating immune receptor prediction.

ranked.headline: Excitability and state transitions framed as phase-plane and maximum entropy dynamics
ranked.summary: Static and mechanistic models now address state transitions across neuronal populations, glial cells, and protein aggregation.

ranked.headline: Inferring dynamic regulatory networks and virtual cell states from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Quantitative dynamic models fitted to single-cell and spatial transcriptomic data now infer regulatory logic governing cell fate and signaling.

ranked.headline: Model-based inference of reaction network dynamics from noisy and time-course data
ranked.summary: Recent work supplies tools to learn governing equations, calibrate kinetic models across labs, and build thermodynamic metabolic models.

ranked.headline: Allosteric Networks Govern Ligand Recognition in Laccase and p53 Y220C
ranked.summary: MD-based network analyses now resolve allosteric routes linking ligand binding to conformational states in enzymes and tumor suppressors.

ranked.headline: Learned protein and sequence representations applied to viral and eukaryotic genomes
ranked.summary: Standardized protein language model embedding access and genome-scale learned models are emerging for viromics and eukaryotic gene prediction.

ranked.headline: Network and competing-history models infer microbial evolutionary structure
ranked.summary: Network-based and evolutionary-game models now infer structure in microbial evolution directly from sequence and metagenomic data.

ranked.headline: Target-conditioned generative models produce ligands, peptides, and cell morphologies
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple generators to pockets, leads, priors, and expert feedback inside the design loop rather than sampling unguided.

ranked.headline: Parameterized network models fit learning rules and circuit architecture to neural data
ranked.summary: Learning rules and circuit architectures are now the fitted quantities, tested across V1 coding, decision policy, and working memory.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide inference of duplication history, chromosome fusion, and hybrid coupling
ranked.summary: Simulation-based calibration of Ks histograms and new chromosome-level and hybrid-zone genome datasets sharpen inference of animal genome evolution.

ranked.headline: New tools visualize RNA pseudoknots, recombination graphs, and gene loss in genomes
ranked.summary: Three recently published tools automate detection of gene loss and visualize RNA pseudoknot layers and ancestral recombination graphs for expert interpretation.

ranked.headline: Generative and hierarchical models align multimodal mouse brain data to reference atlases
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs atlas registration with Bayesian modeling to quantify regional cell counts and geometric variation in brain data.

ranked.headline: Generative design of peptide and ligand binders conditioned on 3D target structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend structure-conditioned generative models to peptide sequence-structure co-design and chirality-agnostic L- and D-peptide binder design.
